text: 15 Take a page of a newspaper. Unfold it. Fold one flap upward. Fold the second flap on the back side. Stick both the corners with glue. Now your cap is ready! 5. Help your friend make a cap by using the above instructions. Fold the right top corner to the crease. Fold the left top corner to the crease. Fold it in a half. Fold it again as shown. 4. Look, listen and do. Let’s make a cap using an old newspaper. Activity Time
